text:
alex: Heads-up — SLO alert triggered for ingress 5xx surge around 16:10 UTC. Can someone point me to the minimal dashboards/log queries to gather evidence (sample traces + request ids) for a quick postmortem? Need links to dashboards and suggestion for alert debounce. Thanks.

rachel: Thanks — start with these: Grafana panel for ingress errors: https://grafana.redwood/display/ingress-errors (rate by status code), and heatmap: https://grafana.redwood/display/ingress-heatmap

rachel: For traces use Jaeger -> service=ingress gateway, operation=proxy_request. Quick search: service=ingress AND http.status_code>=500

devon: I grabbed a couple of trace ids: 8f3a4b2c, 1a9c5d7e. They look like upstream timeouts (504). Sharing curl repro and span links in thread.

alex: paste: `curl -v "https://gateway.redwood/api/v1/generate" -H "x-request-id: 8f3a4b2c"` — got 504

jamal: There was a canary deploy at 16:05 per deploy-bot — may correlate: https://ci.redwood/deploys/2026-03-16-16:04

observability-bot: Query templates -> Logs (sum by status):
```
index=prod-gateway | stats count() by http.status_code | where http.status_code >= 400
```
Also latency by route panel: https://grafana.redwood/display/latency-by-route

kelsey: FYI runtime metrics show a KV-cache evictions spike and increased latency on long-seq models around same window — prob middle-tier backpressure. Perf dash: https://grafana.redwood/display/runtime-kv

rachel: For alert tuning, propose increasing the alert window from 1min->5min for this route and adding a debounce if 5xx is >3% for >4m -> only then page. Also add an annotation in the dashboard for the deploy at 16:05.

devon: +1 on debounce. Also suggest adding a secondary alert for %504 vs %502 to help triage timeouts vs gateway errors.

alex: Perfect. Can someone add the annotation and open a tiny RFC for the alert change? I'll include the trace ids and curl repro. Assign to rachel?

rachel: I'll add the annotation and open a PR with the alert tweak. PR link when ready.

jamal: I'll check CI/deploy logs for the canary rollback timeline and post back.

rachel: PR: https://git.redwood/org/observability/+/1234 — contains alert change and dashboards notes.

alex: thanks team :thumbsup:
